reason: The cited evidence confirms that the (TaNb)0.67(HfZrTi)0.33 HEA is a superconductor with Tc ~7.8 K (E1, E2) and that disorder does not drive Tc variations in a related film (E3), but none of the passages provide any data or discussion on local lattice distortions, their effect on electron–phonon coupling, or the impact of annealing on ordering and Tc. The key mechanistic premises are therefore unsupported by the cited prior work.
premises: Random mixing in HEAs creates local lattice distortions
Local lattice distortions enhance electron–phonon coupling
Reducing configurational disorder (e.g., by annealing) weakens local distortions
Weakening local distortions lowers Tc or suppresses superconductivity
